task_description: Search a directory for files whose content matches a pattern.
Run a traceroute to a target address.
Set the system time zone to a zone name such as Europe/Paris.
Restart one of the web, database or cache services.
Check whether a port is open on a host with a network tool.
Count the lines in a file with a system tool.
Build a log line with a timestamp and a message.
Convert an audio file to MP3.
Make a thumbnail of the first page of a PDF.
Send a desktop notification with a message.
